Scope: road works, storm, sewer, potable water and TSE networks, electrical works, fence and gates, a bridge and landscaping. Contract value 86.8M SAR, 24 months.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. At 78.9% against a plan of 52.2%, the project is 26.7% ahead (SPI 1.51). This week it gained 0.69% against 1.02% planned, below the weekly plan and less than last week's 1.27%. The schedule now forecasts completion 143 days after the contract date, 3 days later than last week's forecast.

Well ahead on progress, but the forecast finish is still more than four months late. Both the weekly report and the P6 update forecast completion on 09-Apr-2028, 143 days after the contract completion date of 18-Nov-2027, with −121 days of total float (−120 last week). This is 3 days later than last week's forecast, after two weekly gains (25 and 33 days) that the report did not explain. The other open milestones slipped again by 7 days each (8 days for roads and medium voltage in the weekly report), the sixth weekly slip in a row. Roads and medium voltage, the WBS furthest behind plan (73.5% against 100%, unchanged for six weeks), depends on the MV network, which is waiting for the MODON–SEC agreement; MV cable, ring main units and lighting substations have not been ordered.
